March 2nd 1920. 191

REPORT ON V. A. Stopany re Lecture on Communism.

Made by D. S. I. Givens

Sir,

Mr. V. A. Stopany, the Russian who addressed
the meeting of the Godown Workers' Union on 29th
ultimo, was called to Headquarters at 11 a.m. 2nd inst.
when the Acting Commissioner of Police warned him that
he would be arrested and deported from China if he again
delivered a lecture of the same tenor. Stopany denied
referring to Communism in his lecture which, he asserted,
was nothing more than an exhortation for the study of
Esperanto.

I am, Sir,

Your obedient servant,

D. S. I.

C. D. O.

关于 V. A. Stopany 发表共产主义演讲的报告。

由侦探副督察 (D. S. I.) Givens 呈报

敬启者：

俄罗斯人 V. A. Stopany 先生于上月29日向仓库工人联合会会议发表演讲，他于本月2日上午11时被传唤至警察总局。代理警务处长警告他，若再次发表相同主旨的演讲，将被逮捕并驱逐出中国。Stopany 否认其在演讲中提及共产主义，他声称那不过是呼吁大家学习世界语 (Esperanto)。

此致，

您顺从的仆人，

CENTRAL POLICE Station.
March 1st 1920. 191

REPRODUCTION Daily Report.

Made by D. S. I. Givens Forwarded by Chief Detective Officer.

Sir,

A Russian named V. A. Stopany, employed in the
Russian Publishing and Printing Co., gave a lecture on
Communism before an audience of some forty employes of
ships and godowns at No. 1746 Koong Tih Foong (公益坊)
North Szechuen Road, at 8 p.m. 29th ultimo. The lecture
was delivered in Esperanto and interpreted into Chinese
by one Loh Sih Kya (陸式階).

After excusing himself for being a poor speaker,
Mr. Stopnay said that Shanghai is a great industrial centre
where the working classes are exploited to an appalling
extent. The majority of the labourers here have to toil
for fourteen hours per day, and the wages they receive
are not even a tenth of the value of their work. The
capitalists enrich themselves by sweating the workers,
and lavish their ill-gotten money on motor cars, carriages
and other luxuries. This state of affairs had already
existed too long, and the lecturer felt that the introduction
of Communism was the only way to end it. Mr. Stopany then
explained the meaning of Communism and gave a brief account
of the success which has attended its application in Russia.
Previous to the introduction of Communism, the workers in
that country were only serfs, but they are now on an equal
footing with the capitalists and aristocracy. He saw no
reason why the workers in Shanghai could not improve their
status in the same way provided they are united and willing
to make sacrifices.

1920年3月1日。 191

日报复写件。

由侦探副督察 (D. S. I.) Givens 制作，经首席侦探官转呈。

敬启者：

一名受雇于俄罗斯出版印刷公司 (Russian Publishing and Printing Co.)、名为 V. A. Stopany 的俄罗斯人，于上月29日晚8时，在四川北路公益坊 (Koong Tih Foong) 1746号，向约四十名船务及仓库雇员发表了一场关于共产主义的演讲。该演讲以世界语进行，并由陆式阶 (Loh Sih Kya) 一人翻译为中文。

Stopany 先生先为自己不善言辞致歉，随后表示上海是一个巨大的工业中心，工人阶级遭受着惊人的剥削。这里的大多数劳工每天必须辛勤工作十四小时，而他们获得的工资甚至不到其劳动价值的十分之一。资本家通过压榨工人致富，并将这些不义之财挥霍在汽车、马车和其他奢侈品上。这种状况已经存在太久，演讲者认为引入共产主义是结束这一局面的唯一途径。随后，Stopany 先生解释了共产主义的含义，并简要介绍了其在俄罗斯应用所取得的成功。在引入共产主义之前，该国的工人仅是农奴，但现在他们已与资本家和贵族处于平等地位。他认为，只要上海的工人们团结起来并愿意做出牺牲，就没有理由不能以同样的方式改善自身的地位。

The lecturer concluded by exhorting the audience
to take up the study of Esperanto as a knowledge of that
language would enable them to promote internationalism and
communism.

The lecture concluded at 9.30 p.m. Mr. Stopany
then presented Tsang Foh Daung( 張福堂 ), one of the
promoters of the Ship and Godown Workers' Union which will be
inaugurated on April 2nd, with a red flag which has a white
square containing a green star in one corner.

One hundred members of various labour unions held
a get-together meeting in the International Institute
at 2.40 p.m. 29th ultimo. Messrs. Tsao Ya Pah( 曹亚伯 )
President of Chung Hwa Labour Union( 中華工黨協會 ), No. 3
Rue Ratard, Hsia Chi Fong( 夏奇峯 ), an Editor of the
Eastern Times, Ming Zung Sung ( 胡潤身 ), a promoter of
Chung Hwa Labour Advancement Union( 中華勞工促进会 ), No. 71
Yangtsepoo Road, Li Hung Ling( 李恒林 ), Chairman of the
Electric Workers' Union, were the prominent persons at
present. These and several others made speeches
urging the workers to organize and unite. The meeting
terminated at 6 p.m.

Thirty members of the Japanese Goods Extinction
Society held a conference at No. 15 Sah Ts Loong( 薩珠弄 ),
inside Old North Gate, at 2.40 p.m. 29th ultimo and decided
to send a party of searchers to various factories where
material of Japanese origin is alleged to be used.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

报告

由 ________________________ 制作，经 ________________________ 转呈

演讲者在结束时呼吁听众开始学习世界语，因为掌握这门语言将使他们能够促进国际主义和共产主义。

演讲于晚上9时30分结束。随后，Stopany 先生向张福堂 (Tsang Foh Daung) 赠送了一面红旗，旗上有一个白色方块，其中一角有一颗绿色星星。张福堂是将于4月2日成立的船务与仓库工人联合会的发起人之一。

上月29日下午2时40分，各工会的一百名成员在国际学社 (International Institute) 举行了一次聚会。出席的主要人物包括：中华工党协会 (Chung Hwa Labour Union) 主席曹亚伯 (Tsao Ya Pah)，地址为辣斐德路 (Rue Ratard) 3号；《时报》(Eastern Times) 编辑夏奇峯 (Hsia Chi Fong)；中华劳工促进会 (Chung Hwa Labour Advancement Union) 发起人胡润身 (Ming Zung Sung)，地址为杨树浦路 (Yangtsepoo Road) 71号；以及电气工人联合会主席李恒林 (Li Hung Ling)。这些人及其他几位发表了演讲，敦促工人组织起来并团结一致。会议于下午6时结束。

上月29日下午2时40分，灭洋货会 (Japanese Goods Extinction Society) 的三十名成员在老北门内的萨珠弄 (Sah Ts Loong) 15号召开会议，决定派遣搜查队前往据称使用日本原料的各工厂进行检查。

此致，

您顺从的仆人，
